facts.fact: Devi audience discovers on phone via Reels tab first (~58-68% historical reel views). Stories retain and drive DM traffic but rarely acquire cold audience. Frame 0 must read on a 6-inch vertical scroll.

Audience feedback is behavioral: skip badge = stop/stay; likes = star-moment/prop/motion; shares often ~0 unless social object; net followers = L1 follow conversion. Never treat account views as per-reel success.

New events (Cannes, Oscars, Coachella, etc.) must load past event lessons via event-lessons-index.json and library anchors (White Luxe, three-word period) before event-specific concept work. FIA lessons transfer to all editorial concept-transfer packs.
Historical peak activity Sunday 6-9am PST (PKT evening). Operator posting default 22:00 IL ≈ 12:00 PDT is acceptable. Cadence spikes on publish day — gap hurts more than imperfect hour.

Account-level reel views can rise 3-4x while individual reel skip badges stay 7-10/10. Distribution success does not prove retention success. Split L1 distribution from L2 stop/stay before scaling. Applies to every event pack.
Feed caption = one staccato line only. Never append art-history or Inspired-by explainers on feed — mobile scroll context; move to pinned comment or Story. Proven on FIA; rule is event-agnostic.
Multi-stage WOW cannot open with classical tableau. STAGE-0 hook (frame 0-0.8s face/prop/peak motion) required on ALL editorial and viral reels before concept setup.
Do not scale batch N+1 on new archetype until batch N clears skip <=6/10 at 72h or Trial regen approved. Event-agnostic gate.
Object/material clarity in frame 0 predicts skip better than mood tableau across editorial packs. Interleave 1 proven hook reel per ~3 experimental slots.
